verdict.rationale: jo's own docs say it keeps the "same memory and context" across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp and email, backed by a per-user cloud machine with persistent storage that keeps working across devices. That implies context carries over between conversations, but it is a single brief claim and does not explicitly describe recalling prior chats and applying relevant details in new ones. Missing for 10: explicit docs on cross-conversation memory recall, how relevant context is selected and applied, user controls to view or edit memory, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
